svg.title: How one question travels through MCP, from your prompt to the model's answer
svg.desc: 1. The MCP client sends server/discover and the weather server replies with its supported versions and capabilities, including tools. 2. The client sends tools/list and the server replies with get_forecast and its input schema, which takes a city and a day. 3. The host gives the model your question and the tool list. 4. The model asks to call get_forecast for Lagos, tomorrow. 5. You approve the call. 6. The host hands the approved call to the MCP client, which sends tools/call for get_forecast with the city and day. 7. The server fetches the forecast from a weather API and returns a result, 80% chance of rain, which the client passes back to the host. 8. The host gives the result to the model, which answers: yes, take an umbrella.
